lines: ...Hm? A... guest?
Ah... forgive me, dear guest. I was simply surprised by your presence.
After all... it's not often that guests stumble upon this simple sanctuary.
...I'm Guide 111, one of dear Juliana's illusory guides, but you may simply call me 111.
I was created to guide guests around her beloved garden.
She's... quite timid when it comes to her talents, but yes, she also created this sanctuary and the garden beyond this painting.
Our dear Juliana has worked hard to create this realm and showcase her talents. It would be an honour to show you around, dear guest...
Don't be... alarmed, but we can step inside the painting to learn more about dear Juliana while we explore the garden.
Hm... would you like to learn about dear Juliana's work experiences... or learn about Juliana herself?
...Very well, dear guest. It may seem strange, but... to enter the garden, we'll need to take the steps and go through the painting.
As your illusory guide, you'll be safe in my company...
...Now, we'll visit the Fountain of Wisdom to learn more about her work experiences.
...Very well, dear guest. Once we take the steps and enter the painting, we'll be within the garden born from her imagination.
As your illusory guide, you'll be safe in my company...
...Now, we'll visit the Field of Wonders to learn more about dear Juliana.
...Welcome to the Fountain of Wisdom, dear guest.
Each location in the garden has an illusory projection that guests can read.
This illusory projection is currently showing dear Juliana's work experiences.
...Ah, right. Please be careful and watch out for the candles...
Guide 555 seems to worry about guests stumbling in the dark... although I find it a bit... overwhelming to see this many candles.
...Welcome to the Field of Wonders, dear guest.
Each location in the garden has an illusory projection that guests can read.
This illusory projection is currently showing dear Juliana's profile.
...I enjoy staying under the tree, whether by myself or with my friends... that is, my fellow illusory guides.
I visit this location so often that... I could've sworn I've seen glimpses of an unidentifiable illusory guide. Only Guide 777 seems to believe me...
...Dear guest, if I may interrupt you for a moment...
You've pressed that mysterious button a total of... [0] times.
Oh, don't misunderstand, dear guest. I'm just as curious as you are about this... button.
Most of us aren't quite sure about this mysterious button...
I often see Guides 222, 333, 444, and 777 in a serious debate over what the button supposedly does.
...Somehow, every debate ends up dragging the rest of us to share our theories... I'd rather wish they didn't.
If you're bored, dear guest...
Might I suggest you poke my brother, Guide 666, instead?
Perhaps, then, he'll stop slacking off and help keep the garden in order.
Well, well, well! You've made a mistake stumbling upon this place, lost soul...
...Haha! Fear not, my dear guest, I was simply kidding!
In fact, however you arrived at this humble sanctuary, consider it a miracle for us! After all, not many people know about this place.
I'm Guide 222, one of Miss Juliana's illusory guides, but you may address me as 222.
It's a pleasure to meet you, my dear guest! I hope you won't mind if I serve as your illusory guide in Miss Juliana's stellar garden.
Miss Juliana doesn't like to be in the spotlight, but know that her imaginative talents brought us illusory guides, this sanctuary, and the garden to life!
She's worked hard to create this realm as a showcase for her talents! Say, you'll explore this realm with me, won't you?
The painting here is essential to entering the garden. Just take my hand and we'll explore the garden as we learn more about Miss Juliana.
Don't be shy, I won't tease you too much, hehe! Now, would you like to learn about Miss Juliana's work experiences or learn about Juliana herself?
Splendid, my dear guest! I can tell you seem uncertain, but simply step inside the painting and you'll enter the garden.
Don't worry, as your illusory guide, I won't leave you alone.
Ahem! Let's visit the Fountain of Wisdom to learn more about her work experiences.
Splendid, my dear guest! Once we enter the painting, you'll trust me to make this journey beyond the painting stellar, won't you?
Don't worry, as your illusory guide, I won't leave you alone.
Ahem! Let's visit the Field of Wonders to learn more about Miss Juliana.
Welcome to the Fountain of Wisdom, my dear guest! See, the trip wasn't so bad, was it?
Illusory projections like this one here are scattered around the garden for guests to read.
At this location, the illusory projection has information about Miss Juliana's work experiences!
I hope you enjoy the scenery, my dear guest! My fellow illusory guides and I made sure to keep this location presentable.
...Hah, Guides 444 and 777 sure do love adding glowing flowers. Perhaps Guide 999 gave 777 the idea...
Welcome to the Field of Wonders, my dear guest! See, the trip wasn't so bad, was it?
Illusory projections like this one here are scattered around the garden for guests to read.
At this location, the illusory projection has information about Miss Juliana herself!
...Guide 111 is a solitary soul; it's no wonder I always see her around here.
I can see why she likes it here! This place is quite peaceful, even if melancholy lingers like petrichor at times.
Well, well! Aren't you silly, my dear guest?
Let me see... I believe you've pressed this mysterious button about [0] times!
Carry on and don't mind me, my dear guest! I'd also love to see what madness awaits!
To be honest, we don't know why Miss Juliana added this mysterious button...
Guides 333, 444, 777, and I have been brainstorming ideas on what purpose this button has!
...Hah! 333 has the nerve to tell me it's pointless to question the button's secrets, but even I can tell that he's just as curious as I am!
Well, well... You're not implying that I'm a boring company, are you?
...Relax, my dear guest! Would you prefer to hear my own thoughts regarding the button?
I can tell that 777 knows something that we don't, but I'm more interested in what 444 knows. After all, she hides it better than 777 does!
